raw: {"mode":"iff","restated":"Ehrhart.normalizedVolume (Ehrhart.centeredSimplex n) = 0 ∨ ∫ x in Ehrhart.centeredSimplex n, x ∂(volume : Measure (Ehrhart.Space n)) = 0","proof":"simp only [Ehrhart.barycenter, smul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero]","english":"Either the centered simplex has volume zero, or the vector-valued integral of the identity function (the unnormalized first moment) over the centered simplex is zero.","why_clearer":"It unfolds the barycenter definition (inverse volume times a vector integral) and, via smul_eq_zero, exposes the degenerate zero-volume case and the actual first-moment vanishing condition."}

parsed.english: Either the centered simplex has volume zero, or the vector-valued integral of the identity function (the unnormalized first moment) over the centered simplex is zero.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the barycenter definition (inverse volume times a vector integral) and, via smul_eq_zero, exposes the degenerate zero-volume case and the actual first-moment vanishing condition.
